description: Source code for a firmware image builder for ZyXEL devices, handling headers, checksums, and image assembly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the firmware image builder, parses options, and initiates image building.

methods.name: build_image
methods.description: Constructs the firmware image by assembling headers, padding rootfs, and writing output.

methods.name: generate_rootfs_header
methods.description: Creates the root filesystem header with checksum and version info.

methods.name: generate_kernel_header
methods.description: Creates the kernel header with checksum and size.

methods.name: generate_board_header
methods.description: Creates the board header with checksum and model name.

methods.name: generate_board_header_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for the board header.

methods.name: sysv_chksm
methods.description: Calculates a 16-bit System V checksum over data.

methods.name: zyxel_chksm
methods.description: Calculates a big-endian checksum for ZyXEL header.
